annotations.title: Search remote jobs at foreign companies

description: Remote roles at foreign companies (techjobs.vn /remote), by default only those someone living in Vietnam can take. For companies hiring in Vietnam use search_jobs.

limit.description: Maximum jobs to return (default 10): up to 10 without sign-in, 50 when signed in.

open_to_vietnam.description: Default true: only roles someone in Vietnam can take. false adds country-restricted ones.

page.description: Page of `limit` results, starting at 1; up to page 3 without sign-in.

query.description: Words in title, company or location, e.g. "backend" or "apac".

role.description: Part of the role name, e.g. "Backend" or "Product Manager".

name: search_remote_jobs

remote_scope.description: worldwide, asia, vietnam, restricted or unknown.

url.description: techjobs.vn page with the JD; share this link.

title: Search remote jobs at foreign companies
